The use of `sha256sums=('SKIP')` for the git source is standard and expected for VCS-based packages, and does not pose a risk during `--printsrcinfo`. The `source` array correctly references a git repository under the declared upstream (`https://github.com/Nambers/rtl8188fu.git`), which is consistent with the package's stated purpose. No network operations or file modifications occur merely by sourcing the PKGBUILD.

All functions (`pkgver`, `prepare`, `package`) are defined but not executed during this phase. Their contents, while including operations like patching and file installation, are irrelevant to the safety of `--printsrcinfo` and will be audited separately later. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no immediate security risk.
</details>
